speaker: Rufus

original_en:
Ah, but that doesn't necessarily mean
that you oppose him!

original_jp: …仕方ない

original_en:
Hold on! I'm not saying I don't believe
you.

original_jp: 一つだけ聞かせてくれ城へ行って王に会ってどうするんだ？
original_en:
Just tell me one thing: What will you do
when you meet the king?

original_jp: 真意と現状を見極めた上で神々との戦争に備えるつもりよ

I'll assess the king's sincerity, then
prepare Dipan for war with the gods.

original_jp: …付き合おう

original_jp: …てことは お役御免だな
original_en:
Which means it's the end of the line
for me.

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: いただく物をいただいて王女様には お別れ申し上げましょうか…
original_en:
I'll just take what's coming to me and
let Her Majesty be on her way.

speaker: Alicia
original_jp: 父の <PART> ――

original_jp: 王の元まで…

speaker: Dylan
original_jp: 頼まれなくてもディパン戦士としてどこまでもお供したい
original_en:
As a loyal knight of Dipan, I will
accompany you anywhere.

speaker: Dylan
original_jp: 見たところ風〓は昔のままだし道案内くらいはできそうだ
original_en:
The land appears much as I remember it.
I think I can lead the way.

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: あんた王女だろ？

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: ここまで来れば〓でも吹けば〓従か誰かすっ〓んで来るだろ？
original_en:
Can't you just toot on a whistle and have
some loyal servant whisk you back there?

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: そろそろ〓〓居はやめにしないか？アリーシャ王女様…
original_en:
Isn't it about time you gave up this
little charade, Princess Alicia?

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: それとも <PART> ――

original_jp: エインフェリアを選定して魂を神界へ導く戦乙女 <PART> ――

Since I can only assume the souls of your
heavens-bound einherjar are listening,

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: ヴァルキリーと呼んだほうが話が早いか…
original_en:
it would be simpler if I just called
you, Valkyrie.

speaker: Silmeria
original_jp: そうね

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: 二人いたのか…！？
original_en: There's two of you in there!

speaker: Silmeria
original_jp: シルメリアよ よろしく

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: 主神オーディンに仕える運命の三女神長女アーリィ 次女レナスの〓…
original_en:
The sister of Hrist and Lenneth. Youngest of
the trinity of goddesses that rule fate under
Odin.

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: でもヴァルキリーの役目がない時は人間に転生しているんじゃ…
original_en:
But, valkyries aren't incarnated as
humans <PART> ---- <PART> not without a reason.

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: …ディパンが神への反逆を〓ててるって噂を聞いた
original_en:
I've heard that Dipan is planning
to rebel against the gods...

speaker: Silmeria
original_jp: 噂がどうあれ 今の私はオーディンに使役されるヴァルキリーではない
original_en:
Whatever you might have heard, this
valkyrie is no longer a servant of Odin's.

speaker: Silmeria
original_jp: 王の娘アリーシャとして転生したはずがオーディンの過ちゆえに覚〓したのよ
original_en:
It was Odin's mistake that awakened me
when I should have been reborn as
Princess Alicia.

speaker: Alicia
original_jp: このまま城までご一緒願えませんか？
original_en: Please, won't you escort me to the castle?

that and bring it back to Odin!
